description: Overview of major martial arts traditions, their origins, techniques, and philosophy

overview.definition: Codified systems and traditions of combat practices; blend physical, mental, and spiritual training

boxing.origin: Ancient Greece; formalized in England 18th century

muay_thai.nickname: Art of Eight Limbs (fists, elbows, knees, shins)
muay_thai.techniques: Clinch work, teep (push kick), roundhouse, flying knee
muay_thai.significance: Dominant in stand-up striking; foundation of modern MMA

karate.origin: Okinawa, Japan; influenced by Chinese kung fu
karate.philosophy: Karate ni sente nashi (no first strike in karate)

taekwondo.characteristics: High-speed kicking; flying and spinning kicks

kung_fu_wushu.origin: China; thousands of years of tradition
kung_fu_wushu.styles: 500+ styles; Northern (kicks, acrobatics) vs Southern (hand techniques)
kung_fu_wushu.philosophy: Balance of hard and soft; harmony with nature

judo.philosophy: Judo = 'gentle way'; maximum efficiency, minimum effort

styles.greco_roman: Upper body only; no leg grabs; Olympic since 1896
styles.freestyle: Full body; leg attacks allowed; Olympic
styles.folkstyle: American collegiate; control on ground emphasized

wrestling.ancient_history: Depicted in ancient Greek, Egyptian, and Chinese art

brazilian_jiu_jitsu.principle: Ground fighting; technique over strength; smaller can defeat larger opponent
brazilian_jiu_jitsu.positions: Guard, mount, side control, back control
brazilian_jiu_jitsu.submissions: Chokes (rear naked, triangle, guillotine), joint locks (armbar, kimura)
brazilian_jiu_jitsu.impact: Revolutionized MMA; UFC's early success showed BJJ dominance

sumo.origin: Japan; 2,000+ year history; Shinto religious origins
sumo.objective: Force opponent out of ring (dohyo) or touch ground with anything except feet

weapon_arts.kendo: Japanese way of the sword; bamboo sword (shinai), protective armor
weapon_arts.iaido: Art of drawing and cutting with katana
weapon_arts.fencing: European sword fighting; foil, épée, sabre; Olympic since 1896
weapon_arts.archery: Olympic sport; recurve and compound bows

mma.definition: Mixed Martial Arts; combines striking and grappling from multiple disciplines
mma.ufc: Ultimate Fighting Championship; founded 1993; largest MMA organization
mma.common_backgrounds: BJJ, wrestling, boxing, Muay Thai, judo

philosophy.bushido: Samurai code; loyalty, honor, martial arts mastery, death before dishonor
philosophy.budo: Japanese martial way; moral and spiritual development through practice
philosophy.wu_de: Martial virtue; Chinese martial morality; respect, integrity, perseverance
